MAIN-GREEN DEFECT IN THIS TICKET'S OWN FILE, found and fixed. The scheduled Terraform Drift workflow has been FAILING ON MAIN at its 'terraform fmt -check' step (exit 3), naming infra/terraform/monitoring_9ea3.tf -- this ticket's file.

Cause: alarm_name was padded for alignment against a neighbouring line that is a COMMENT, and terraform does not align across comments, so fmt wants:
  -  alarm_name        = "rebar-mcp-serving-path-down"
  +  alarm_name = "rebar-mcp-serving-path-down"

Consequence worth noting: the fmt step is FIRST, so the plan job never ran at all. The Drift workflow has therefore not been checking for actual infrastructure drift -- a whitespace defect was masking the entire purpose of that workflow. That is the fourth instance today of the same shape: absence of execution presenting as a failure or a pass without anyone noticing what did not run.

Fixed and pushed as Gerrit change 2614: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2614
'terraform fmt -check -recursive infra/terraform' is now clean. Whitespace only; no alarm semantics change.

Committed under THIS ticket's trailer rather than opening a new one: 9ea3 is in_progress and held by me, the defect is in 9ea3's own file, and a separate ticket plus a 15-20 minute plan-review cycle for a one-line formatting fix would be ceremony without information. Recording the reasoning here so the trailer is not mistaken for scope creep.
